rounds.text: The business suffers from stagnant top-line momentum, evidenced by a 3-year compounded sales growth of -1% and a poor 5-year sales growth rate of just 5% [E16, E61]. This sluggish growth is accompanied by deteriorating profitability metrics, including a 3-year compounded profit growth of -1% and a contraction in operating margins down to 9% in March 2026 compared to 11% three years prior and 12% in the year-ago quarter [E20, E29, E30]. Furthermore, reported earnings quality is compromised because they include Rs 9.66 Cr of other income, while long-term return on equity remains low at 9.7% to 9.88% over recent periods [E13, E62, E63]. Insiders are steadily exiting their positions, with promoter holding decreasing by 6.10 percentage points from 74.30% in September 2023 to 68.20% in June 2026 [E41, E65]. Valuation risks are underscored by an EV/EBITDA of 6.6x and a Price-to-Book of 1.21x, both of which sit above their respective sector benchmarks of 4.88x and 0.86x [E7, E11]. Finally, the stock carries severe historical downside risk, demonstrated by a worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -71.8% and a negative 12-month price return [E24, E52]. Conceded: [E37].
